[[File:FoolsGold-TwinStarsOfKira.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Fool's Gold'']]
The '''''Fool's Gold''''' was a legendary [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Bruce Mercy]] wanted to find. Mercy and his band of pirates attempted to steal the location of the ''Fool{{'s}} Gold'' from [[Plako]], but were beaten to the ship by a group of free-lancing adventurers.
